Emily — attaching the artifacts here and via the shared drive. Quick clarifications to preempt questions from your team:
- Retention tiers: ephemeral logs (default) are kept for 24 hours for routing/kv cache purposes and then are purged; short-term diagnostic logs are kept 30 days encrypted; audit-only minimal metadata (request_id, timestamp, model_version, token_count) is retained for up to 365 days for billing and SLA investigation.
- Redaction: we run a two-stage pipeline. First pass: deterministic regex and ML-based PII detector at ingest; second pass: any flagged items are queued to a small security ops queue for human review within 48 hours. If sensitive content is confirmed, full content is redacted and only minimal metadata is retained.
- Training: customer content is not used for model training unless there is a contractual opt-in (explicit checkbox in onboarding + procurement clause). We surface opt-ins in the console and maintain an audit log of consent.

Attachments included (stubbed): sample-prompt-logs-202707.csv (CSV, 25 rows), redaction-playbook.pdf (PDF), redacted-sample-letters.txt (TXT, 3 examples), SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (PDF, 2 pages).

Let me know if you want an anonymized time-series showing token-volume vs retention tier — we can generate that quickly.

Best,

Emily — short answers below and copying them into the HubSpot evidence note. We'll also update the playbook PDF to remove the inconsistency.

1) Ephemeral default: 24 hours in the hosted API (this is configurable per-customer; the 1h mention in the playbook was an internal experimental retention tier we piloted in a subset of infra).
2) Human review: reviewers sit within our Security Ops team (not contractor crowdworkers). Every review action is logged in our audit service (who reviewed, timestamp, decision, redaction hashes). Those audit entries are encrypted and retained per our audit retention policy (365 days).
3) Token_count: computed pre-redaction so analytics and billing reflect the original request size. The CSV sample preserves token_count as measured at ingest.

Emily — you should be able to access the artifacts (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CareBridge/SIG-evidence). If you need the full SOC2 report or a signed NDA, tell us and we'll route to procurement.
